name: get_destination_connector
summary: Get Configuration Details of a Destination Connector
description: Retrieves the configuration settings that a Destination connector accepts, including their data type, whether they are required, their default value, and the values they allow. Hevo returns these settings as a JSON schema draft 2020-12 definition, in which the settings specific to the connector are grouped under `config`. Use this schema to build the request body that you send to the [Create a Destination](/reference/post_api-v2-destinations) endpoint or in the `destination` object that you send to the [Create a Pipeline](/reference/post_api-v2-pipelines) endpoint, or to validate it before you send the request. The schema states the following: - A key listed under `required` must always be sent. A key that Hevo fills with a default value when it is not sent is not required. - A key that applies only under a condition, such as the credentials of a specific authentication method, is defined in an `if`/`then` block inside `allOf`, and is required only when that condition is met. - A credential is a string marked `writeOnly: true` and `format: password`. Credentials are accepted while creating a Destination, or when you modify it, and are masked in every response. - A key that accepts a fixed set of values is defined as a `oneOf` list of `const` values, each with its display name in `title`. - If the value of a key must be in a particular format, the key is defined with a `pattern`, which is a regular expression that the value must match. Hevo rejects a value that does not match it. Refer to [Read the Connector Configuration](/reference/creating-destinations-with-hevo-api#step-1-read-the-connector-configuration) for more information about how to read this schema and build a request from it.

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the connector, as returned by the [List All Destination Connectors](/reference/get_api-v2-metadata-destinations-connectors) endpoint. Send this value exactly as that endpoint returns it.
parameters.name: connector_id

code.description: Status of the API call. Returns `Success` for a successful request.

type.description: Type of the Destination that the connector loads data into.

schema.description: JSON schema of the request body that you send while creating a Destination with this connector. The keys of this object are JSON schema keywords and the configuration keys of the connector, spelled exactly as you send them.
